visual_design.single_minded_proposition: One truthful reason this product deserves attention.
visual_design.audience_tension: What the audience wants and what currently blocks belief or desire.
visual_design.visual_proof: One evidence-backed material, scale, use, or identity proof.
visual_design.big_idea: A memorable visual organizing idea, not a style label.
visual_design.proof_mode: identity | material | scale | process | function | experience | truthful transformation
visual_design.talent_value: none_product_led | desire | trust | scale | use_proof | emotion
visual_design.talent_role: Use a person only to strengthen desire, trust, scale, use proof, or emotion.
visual_design.sound_intent: Layered commercial sound that reinforces every visible selling beat.

sound_design.sonic_idea: One memorable sonic idea that expresses the same commercial promise as the images.
sound_design.signature_sfx: product- and action-appropriate sonic accents synchronized to visible actions and cuts
sound_design.music: restrained original instrumental underscore, no vocals or lyrics
sound_design.energy_curve: hook lift, proof focus, payoff resolution
sound_design.mix: voice clear in front; signature SFX audible; ambience subtle and continuous; music ducked under speech
sound_design.continuity_strategy: Restate the full sonic fingerprint inside every independently generated clip; never write same as previous or 沿用上一段.
sound_design.exact_score_continuity_note: Exact identical music across independent generations requires a separately approved local post-production mix.

visual_design.creative_thesis: One clear product promise expressed through a product-first commercial story.

visual_system.palette: derived from the supplied product and brand materials
visual_system.lighting: premium commercial key light with controlled highlights
visual_system.lens_language: macro proof, human-scale demonstration, clean hero ending
